_note: Abilities shared by every unit. Basic attacks are referenced by ClassDef.basicAttack.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: Start attacking the target with your melee weapon(s). Auto attacks happen at the end of your turn while the target is in reach.

abilities.name: Auto Shot
abilities.description: Start shooting the target with your bow, gun or crossbow. Shots happen at the end of your turn while the target is in range and outside the 8 yard dead zone.

abilities.name: Shoot
abilities.description: Shoot your wand at the target. Takes as long as the wand's speed.

abilities.name: Help
abilities.description: Help a downed ally back to their feet with 1 health.

specials.behaviour: Wand shot: time cost = equipped ranged weapon speed (instead of GCD); one ranged weapon hit using the wand's damage and damageSchool; no AP bonus; can crit as a spell (x1.5).
Target must be a Downed ally within melee reach. Revives them with 1 health; they act normally from their next turn.
